title: Feature request - Falling and rising fast alarm
symptom: User requests a feature to add glucose values to the falling and rising fast alarm, so that the alarm only rings when glucose is below/above certain thresholds, to avoid expected alarms at high glucose levels.
fix: The maintainer suggests using the existing Forecasted Low alarm for falling fast, and mentions a predicted high alarm pull request for rising fast, but no concrete fix is provided.
evidence_quote: The functionality you are asking for by adding a value to fast rising can effectively be accomplished by using the existing predicted low alarm as already explained.
